full_prompt_en: A square storybook illustration in finely outlined watercolor shows a cloaked traveler and a smaller companion moving across a snowy rocky slope under a dark blue winter sky. The background is a broad field of textured midnight blue, interrupted by bare white branches and the faceted silhouette of a large stone outcrop. Pale snow rests on the upper ledges and forms an angular band across the lower foreground. Near the center-right, the taller figure leans forward in profile, looking toward the left. A light cream cloak billows behind the shoulders, contrasting with a rust-orange skirt and patterned blue-violet fabric beneath it. Warm brown straps and layered garments cross the torso, and a long slender staff angles down toward the lower edge. Slightly behind and below, a smaller bundled figure steps among the rocks, with pale head covering and soft brown clothing. The figures are placed tightly against the outcrop, their rounded garments and careful gestures offsetting its hard triangular planes. Thin dark outlines define faces, fabric folds, branches, and stone cracks, while translucent color settles unevenly inside those contours. Flecks of ochre and muted violet enliven the cool blue-gray rocks; the orange garment provides the clearest warm accent in the scene. The watercolor surface has a softly mottled, aged-paper quality, and the snow remains nearly unpainted ivory with slight cool shading at its edges. Diffuse cold light reaches the figures from the open sky, brightening the cloak and snow without a hard cast shadow; deeper blue and charcoal collect in the crevices and behind the travelers. The overall composition sets a small human passage against a steep, quiet landscape, balancing fine decorative line with restrained winter color.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形故事书插画，以细致勾线的水彩描绘一位披风旅人和较小的同行者，在深蓝冬日天空下穿过覆雪的岩坡。背景是一大片带肌理的午夜蓝，被光秃的白色枝条和巨大岩块的多面剪影打断。浅色积雪覆在上方岩架，也在下方前景形成折角的色带。靠近中部偏右，较高的人物侧身前倾，望向左方。浅奶油色披风从肩后鼓起，与锈橙色下装及其下蓝紫色纹样织物形成对比。暖褐色带子和层叠衣物横过躯干，一根细长手杖斜向画面下缘。稍靠后且较低的位置，一位包裹严实的小人物踏过岩石，头部有浅色覆盖物，身着柔和褐色衣物。两人紧贴岩块布置，圆润的衣物和谨慎的动作与坚硬的三角岩面相抵。纤细的深色轮廓勾勒面部、布褶、树枝和石缝，半透明色彩在轮廓内不均匀地沉积。赭色和低调紫色的斑点使冷蓝灰岩石生动起来；橙色衣物是画面最鲜明的暖色强调。水彩表面有柔和斑驳的旧纸质感，积雪近乎保持未着色的象牙白，仅在边缘带有淡淡冷调阴影。来自开阔天空的漫射冷光照亮人物的披风和雪面，却没有坚硬投影；较深的蓝与炭灰聚集在石缝以及旅人身后。整体构图将小小的行旅放在陡峭安静的景观之中，以细密装饰线条平衡克制的冬日色彩。
style_prompt_en: The image has the character of an early illustrated storybook plate, combining delicate dark contour lines with translucent watercolor washes. Large cool areas of textured blue and blue gray support smaller accents of rusty orange, muted violet, ochre, and warm ivory. Angular planes receive softly pooling pigment, while curved forms and fine branching lines create movement across the surface. Outlines remain legible even where color bleeds slightly, so decorative detail coexists with broad quiet areas. Pale unpainted passages work as luminous highlights against deeper mottled washes. Diffuse ambient light keeps shadows gentle, and layered contours provide depth without a photographic finish. The result is intricate and atmospheric, with disciplined linework and an aged paper softness.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有早期故事书插页的气质，将纤细深色轮廓线与半透明水彩晕染结合。大面积带肌理的冷蓝、蓝灰承托少量锈橙、低调紫、赭色和暖象牙色。折角平面上颜料柔和沉积，弯曲形体与细分叉线条则带动表面节奏。色彩即使轻微渗化，轮廓仍可读，使装饰细节与宽阔安静区域并存。浅色留白在更深的斑驳色层旁成为发光的高光。漫射环境光让阴影柔和，层叠轮廓提供纵深而不呈摄影式完成面。整体精巧且富于氛围，以严谨线描和旧纸般柔软感共同构成。
theme_en: A cloaked traveler and a small companion on a snowy rocky slope
theme_zh: 雪覆岩坡上的披风旅人与小同行者
name: Charles Robinson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
